confirmed_baseline: Single-document merge plus necessary asset/reference changes only
Undo cannot delete material still used elsewhere
Formal save retains recovery versions until an approved retention policy cleans them
M02 C+B pending precision does not block this independent M05 preparation review

current_source_evidence.filesystem_port: Seven generic methods. No reference-root completeness, lease, revision fence or catalog transaction contract. Presence of remove_file does not authorize GC.
current_source_evidence.old_envelope: 11 candidate files are listed, but exact new types, output port and transaction seam are not approved.

findings.finding: Unknown roots must be distinguished from a complete empty reference set. Existing three test rows do not encode all root providers or completeness.
findings.disposition: Add explicit conservative root evaluation plan; do not implement deletion.

findings.finding: Reference scan then remove_file has an unprotected time-of-check/time-of-use window. Generic FS API is not proof of safe physical deletion.
findings.disposition: Require approved root snapshot revision/fence and exclusive cleanup transaction capability before a physical cleanup slice.

findings.finding: Old B1-B12 rows all say Applicable but do not map to executable per-category cases; source-file targets alone do not establish module coverage.
findings.disposition: 18 proposed cases below map all twelve categories; target/fixtures are still not created.

findings.finding: Old source inventory has drifted where listed. It cannot be reused as current acceptance evidence.
findings.disposition: Fresh source hashes verified against current 786-file baseline; preserve old report as historical.

architecture_proposal.hexagonal_view: UI/Test -> Input port -> HOST collect/evaluate -> WORK pure eligibility policy; HOST -> explicit root-provider and mutation capabilities <- owning modules/adapters.
architecture_proposal.dependency_view: M04 history projection + all document owners + M07 retained snapshots + in-flight transaction owner -> immutable completeness/revision projection -> M05 evaluator. M05 must not mutate providers.
architecture_proposal.state_ownership: Documents own references; M04 owns history; M07 owns recovery index; transaction owner owns temporary claims; M05 owns immutable asset identity/catalog only. Collected roots are derived projections, not an independent SSOT.
architecture_proposal.mutation_boundary: Evaluation is read-only. Later physical cleanup requires separately approved application transaction, complete root set and freshness fence. No direct UI-to-FS.
architecture_proposal.transaction_boundary: Collect complete roots -> evaluate bound candidate -> preview -> revalidate under approved exclusion -> delete only eligible owned bytes -> update catalog consistently. Missing seam means REPLAN_REQUIRED, not best-effort deletion.
architecture_proposal.candidate_first_slice: Pure evaluator only: immutable candidate identity/ownership plus root observations -> Retain(reasons), Ineligible(reason) or EligibleForCleanup. Eligibility is not deletion authority. No persistence/OS/clock/new output Port in this first slice.
architecture_proposal.protected: No product file or executable test may be changed by this review. Existing M05 envelope remains proposed, not silently expanded.
